title: cenchrus durus
intro: Cenchrus durus, commonly known as Broom Grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various health issues due to its high nutritional value and antioxidant content. The health benefits of Cenchrus durus include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and lower blood pressure, making it a potential natural remedy for several chronic diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
